It aims to analyze the relationship between a premise and a hypothesis, categorizing them into entailment, contradiction, or neutral. The distillation process makes this model lighter and faster, while still retaining a good level of performance on NLI tasks. It's a great choice for applications with limited computational resources but still requiring reliable NLI capabilities.
examples: Analyzing text for logical soundness in news articles
Evaluating argumentative consistency in op-eds
Verifying logical coherence in academic publications
Evaluating consistency of statements in technical reports
Detecting contradictions in press releases
Analyzing logical relationships in book summaries
Verifying factual alignment in documentary scripts
